notes.title: The Test Updates & New Features + The Test: Reality Check
notes.notes:
[b][h1]The Test Updates & New Features[/h1]

The Test has been updated with some new questions, rotating questions (Meaning each playthrough will differ slightly from one another. The chances of you getting the exact same playthrough twice or the same playthrough as another player are slim to none. Your experience may feel similar and most questions may remain the same, but there will be slight differences and various questions reworded that will change the meaning entirely.)

New updates to the ending message where new opportunities are presented for players to be involved in upcoming projects, as well as for The Test: Reality Check, a brand new featured title in the series that just released.

We hope you enjoy your experience, and we hope to see you in the rest of our series!

We appreciate your support and look forward to reading your comments! ♥[/b]

notes.title: Discounts and news! Summer Sale!
notes.notes:
[b]All games are currently on sale for the summer sale!

Also, we are reaching out to players directly to select folks to pick the names of characters to appear in our upcoming titles.

You may receive a friend request from one of our alternate accounts.

You will never be asked for compensation, this is 100% free, no catch, no sign ups, no information required.

notes.title: New Titles Releasing + Secret Words!
notes.notes:
[b]Your Secret Words Are ALWAYS Useful.

Thank you so much to everyone who has left their secret words for us!
We've read through the reviews you've left, and they've helped us A TON across all of our titles! We really appreciate your support, it means the world to us!

We've seen some people wondering if Secret Words are still useful and if they still matter from games like The Test or The Horrorscope, despite the sequels to those games already being made. The answer is ABSOLUTELY Yes, they do!
After reading through comments and reviews, we take the secret words and the Players who leave those comments, and we use them to create something incredibly special in upcoming projects. Even once we're done with those, we STILL go back to our original titles and pull names and secret words to use. So if you see your name in a future title, it's because you took the time to leave your word for us! Regardless of how long the title has been out, we still go back and look at the new names and words daily.

Also, with that being said, Players who leave secret words for us across multiple titles, your names are likely to be appear multiple times in upcoming titles. Thank you so much for your continued support, it really means a ton and we can't wait to reveal our big project in the final Test installment. Until then, while we're still working on The Test 3 and what's coming afterwards, we'll continue to release more question-based games as people seem to rather enjoy them. The Secret Words used in these games will all contribute towards our main project that's still in the making as well. So again, thank you for your continued support. It truly means a lot!

We've also reduced the price of The Summoning and The Twins so more people can afford them. We know that these titles are a little different than what our question-based games have to offer, but if you've got an open-mind, we think you can enjoy them and find some common ground between our other titles. Who knows, you might even enjoy them more! Let us know what you think! In the meantime, we'll be working on new titles.

Oh yeah... Speaking of new titles... We're releasing two of them on August 24th and September 7th. You can check them out here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1379020/The_Horrorscope_Fatal_Awakening/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1397030/Survive_or_Thrive/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/13174/Randumb_Studios_Deluxe_Bundle/


We love hearing from you and reading your comments.
Once again, thank you for being awesome.
- Randumb Studios [/b]

notes.title: The Confession is releasing today!
notes.notes:
[h1] The Confession [/h1]

[b] Hello everyone! We'd like to keep this short and sweet as to not bore you to death with endless reading! [u] The Confession [/u] releases today, May 18th, at approximately 10:00 AM PST, 6:00 PM GMT! 

What is [u] The Confession? [/u] Well, in essence, [u] The Confession [/u] is a parody of our previous work and titles. It's our way of reading the feedback players have left for us, taking their words, good and bad, into heavy consideration, and making fun of what we've managed to create thus far! This title is not meant to be taken seriously, however, it doesn't mean it's not worth playing! Instead of giving you some sort of mind-blowing result, what we've attempted to accomplish here, is to simply put a smile on your face, perhaps a bit of disgust in your stomach, and unleash the inner-WTFness within all of us! We wanted to create something ridiculous, something unique, and something fun for all involved! We hope that you enjoy what we've managed to put together for you.

Warning: [u] The Confession [/u] is an adult-themed game with graphic textual details. It is not intended for younger audiences or those who are prudish in any way, shape, or form. Some of the topics involved may be deemed lewd, crude, and incredibly offensive. We hope you enjoy your time playing, and may your panties remain unbunched! 

(You can find [u] The Confession [/u] in this link below:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1289640/The_Confession/

Or you can pick it up in our full game bundle for over 30% off upon release!
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/13174/The_Test_Summoning_Twins_Naked_News_Horrorscope_Bundle/


Now that that's out of the way! We also want to announce that we're currently working on a new title that's INCREDIBLY different from anything else we've released thus far! We're extremely excited about it, and we feel like it's several steps above anything we've managed to put together thus far. If you've enjoyed our previous titles, we're absolutely certain you're going to enjoy the thrill-ride that we're working on now! It will be similar enough where you can compare some of the aspects to our current titles, but done in a much different way with a much different theme. However, as with all of our titles, our key feature that we attempt to accomplish every single time, is to invoke emotion within our audience, and we're absolutely certain that our current project is going to invoke a hell of a lot of emotion upon its release! Get on board, stay tuned, and enjoy!

- Randumb Studios
 
 [/b]

notes.title: The Test 2, Coming April 27th!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone! (Below is a link to The Test 2)

We'd like to thank you all for the continued support through our projects!
We'd like to announce that The Test 2 is nearly finished and releasing this month on April 27th, 2020! We've read each and every single comment and review left for us and we've incorporated your feedback into the making of The Test 2, known as, "The Test: Hypothesis Rising."

We've also begun developing multiple other projects, including The Horoscope 2 and a few others, which will all lead into something major that we have planned, (And also the main usage and purpose of everyone's secret words.)

We like the conspiracy theories behind the usage of the secret words we use in our games, but so far no one has figured out what we're doing with them, which adds an element of fun for us as everyone attempts to decipher what's going on! All we can say is, we want to make sure that those who participate are GLAD they took the leap of faith and participated, and those who missed out will feel really foolish. That's our goal, to make FEELINGS happen.
That's why we at Randumb studios don't create games... We create experiences! 😊

At the minimum so far, what we've done is added in thousands of names into our credits for those who have participated thus far, and those who continue to participate up until the release of The Test: Hypothesis rising, though any who participate in the future will also have their names in the credits of future games and current projects we're working on.
We feel like this is the LEAST we can do to show our appreciation for your support and make sure that no matter how big or small of a role that each individual plays, each person individually gets recognition for making the effort, forever!

Again, from the bottom of our hearts, thank you so much for following us on this journey and making everything happen! We're excited to work on the final part of The Test trilogy with a third and final installment, and ultimate reveal, as time goes on.

With love, - Randumb Studios[/b]
